column1: # State is complete, partial, or missing. "Complete" requires a differential
# probe of the command's PostgreSQL-visible semantics, not merely accepting its
# first keyword. This file is a whole-product ratchet: 100% PostgreSQL command
# fidelity is reached only when every row is complete and
# tools/check-pg18-surface.sh passes. Individual fat PRs advance the measured
# states without pretending that the remaining surface is complete.
